# Errors

<!-- Generated by `make error-docs` from apps/api/src/detent/api/error_codes.py. Do not edit. -->

Every error response has the same shape:

```json
{"error": {"type": "conflict", "code": "payment_blocked", "message": "...",
           "payment_id": "pay_...", "request_id": "req_...", "param": null}}
```

Branch on `type` for the broad class and on `code` for the exact reason. `message` is for
people and may change. Quote `request_id` when you contact DekernAI; it is also on the
`Request-Id` header.

## `invalid_request`

| Code | HTTP | Meaning | What to do |
|---|---|---|---|
| `validation_error` | 422 | A field is missing, has the wrong type or is out of range. `param` names it. | Fix the field named in `param` and send the request again. |
| `unknown_version` | 400 | The `DekernAI-Version` header names a version that does not exist. | Send a supported dated version, or leave the header out to use your organisation's pinned one. |
| `bad_request` | 400 | The request could not be read, for example a malformed path parameter. | Check the request against the API reference. |
| `method_not_allowed` | 405 | The path exists, but not with this HTTP method. | Use the method shown in the API reference. |
| `unsupported_network` | 422 | The destination or deposit network is not one the sandbox supports. | Use `base-sepolia`, `eth-sepolia` or a bank rail from the reference. |
| `network_not_allowed` | 422 | The network is supported but not enabled for your organisation. | Choose an enabled network, or ask your DekernAI contact to enable it. |
| `currency_mismatch` | 422 | The currency does not match the destination or the expected amount. | Send the amount in the currency of the destination. |
| `currency_network_mismatch` | 422 | The currency is not available on the chosen network. | Pick a network that carries the currency. |
| `invalid_amount` | 422 | The amount is not a positive decimal string with the currency's precision. | Send the amount as a string such as `"18500.00"`. |
| `mandate_invalid` | 422 | The mandate is unknown, revoked, expired or not signed for this agent. | Use an active mandate ID for the agent's key. |
| `user_payouts_unavailable` | 422 | Payouts to end users are not available in the sandbox yet. | Pay a counterparty instead. |
| `invalid_mode` | 422 | The execution mode is not one of `shadow`, `assist` or `auto`. | Send one of the three modes. |
| `invalid_url` | 422 | The webhook URL is not https://, carries credentials, or points at a private address. | Use a public https:// URL. |
| `unknown_event_type` | 422 | An event type is not one of the documented types. | Use the types listed in the webhooks reference, or "*" for all. |
| `reason_required` | 422 | This action needs a written reason. | Send a non-empty `reason`. |

## `authentication`

| Code | HTTP | Meaning | What to do |
|---|---|---|---|
| `missing_api_key` | 401 | No `Authorization: Bearer` header was sent. | Send `Authorization: Bearer sk_test_...`. |
| `invalid_api_key` | 401 | The key is unknown, revoked or expired. | Create a new test key in the dashboard. |

## `permission`

| Code | HTTP | Meaning | What to do |
|---|---|---|---|
| `live_mode_unavailable` | 403 | A live key was sent. DekernAI runs on test networks only. | Use an `sk_test_` key. |
| `insufficient_scope` | 403 | The key does not carry the scope this endpoint needs. | Use a key with the scope shown in the API reference. |
| `insufficient_role` | 403 | The user behind the key does not hold the role this action needs. | Ask a user with the right role, for example the payments lead. |
| `self_approval_forbidden` | 403 | The approver is the person who started the payment. | Ask a second person to approve. |
| `mandate_mismatch` | 403 | The intent names a mandate that is not the one bound to this agent key. | Send the mandate ID bound to the key, or leave it out. |
| `organisation_expired` | 403 | The sandbox organisation has passed its expiry date and is locked. | Contact DekernAI to extend the sandbox. |
| `organisation_suspended` | 403 | DekernAI has suspended the organisation; it is read-only until reinstated. | Contact DekernAI. |
| `forbidden` | 403 | The action is not allowed for this caller. | Check the scope and role the endpoint needs. |

## `not_found`

| Code | HTTP | Meaning | What to do |
|---|---|---|---|
| `not_found` | 404 | No such object in your organisation, or no such path. | Check the ID. Objects from another organisation are never visible. |

## `conflict`

| Code | HTTP | Meaning | What to do |
|---|---|---|---|
| `conflict` | 409 | The object is in a state that does not allow this action. | Read the object again and act on its current state. |
| `idempotency_conflict` | 409 | This `Idempotency-Key` was already used with a different request body. | Use a new key for a new request; resend the same body to get the stored response. |
| `idempotency_key_reused` | 409 | This `Idempotency-Key` was already used for a different kind of request. | Use a new key for each new request. |
| `already_resolved` | 409 | The case was already approved or rejected. | Read the case to see its outcome. |
| `payment_blocked` | 409 | The payment was BLOCKED. A block is final and is never approved, retried or resent. | Create a new intent only if the reason for the block no longer applies. |
| `resolve_via_reconciliation` | 409 | The payment's outcome is UNKNOWN; only rail evidence through reconciliation can resolve it. | Wait for reconciliation. Never resend while the outcome is UNKNOWN. |
| `too_many_endpoints` | 409 | The organisation already has the maximum number of enabled webhook endpoints. | Disable an endpoint you no longer use. |
| `endpoint_disabled` | 409 | The webhook endpoint is disabled. | Create a new endpoint. |
| `shadow_mode` | 409 | The organisation is in shadow mode, so nothing is sent. | Switch to assist or auto mode in the console to send. |

## `rate_limit`

| Code | HTTP | Meaning | What to do |
|---|---|---|---|
| `rate_limited` | 429 | Too many requests for this key or client address in the current window. | Wait for the seconds in `Retry-After`, then retry. |

## `internal`

| Code | HTTP | Meaning | What to do |
|---|---|---|---|
| `webhooks_unavailable` | 503 | Webhooks are not configured on this instance, so no endpoint can be created or signed. | Contact DekernAI; nothing was created. |
| `internal_error` | 500 | Something went wrong on DekernAI's side. Nothing was executed because of it. | Retry with the same `Idempotency-Key`; quote the `request_id` if it persists. |
